replication.claim: The world model's latents encode the car's state
replication.published: linear probes: position R² ≈ 0.95, velocity ≈ 0.90 (Wurgaft et al. App. B)
replication.criterion: position R² ≥ 0.8 and ≥ 0.2 above the untrained encoder

replication.claim: Distances along the manifold match distances in the world; straight lines don't
replication.ours: r = 0.994 [0.992, 0.995] along the spline vs 0.472 for straight chords (50 anchors, 1,225 pairs; 95% CI over rollouts)

replication.claim: Control: the isometry is specific to the trained model
replication.published: the manifold reflects learned world structure
replication.ours: untrained encoder: arc r = 0.998, chord r = 0.419 (trained: 0.994 / 0.472); contrast -0.058 [-0.075, -0.014] (95% CI over rollouts)
replication.criterion: trained arc-minus-chord gap ≥ 0.2 larger than the untrained encoder's
replication.post_hoc: control added after the methods review
